claim: 长工时2016年造成74.5万人死于中风和缺血性心脏病；每周工作55小时以上者中风风险比35-40小时者高约35%，缺血性心脏病死亡风险高17%
author: 世界卫生组织与国际劳工组织
credentials: 世界卫生组织与国际劳工组织联合发布的首个全球长工时疾病负担估算（发表于Environment International）
title: Long working hours increasing deaths from heart disease and stroke: WHO, ILO - PAHO/WHO | Pan American Health Organization
quote: Long working hours led to 745 000 deaths from stroke and ischemic heart disease in 2016 ... The study concludes that working 55 or more hours per week is associated with an estimated 35% higher risk of a stroke and a 17% higher risk of dying from ischemic heart disease, compared to working 35-40 hours a week.

claim: 141家机构、2896名员工的保薪四天工作制试验显示倦怠、工作满意度、身心健康均改善，对照组未见此变化
author: Wen Fan, Juliet B. Schor, Orla Kelly, Guolin Gu
credentials: 波士顿学院社会学与经济学教授，同行评审期刊论文（摘要经RePEc/IDEAS收录）
title: Work time reduction via a 4-day workweek finds improvements in workers’ well-being
quote: Analysis of pre- and post-trial data from 2,896 employees across 141 organizations in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK and the USA shows improvements in burnout, job satisfaction, mental health and physical health—a pattern not observed in 12 control companies. ... The results indicate that income-preserving 4-day workweeks are an effective organizational intervention for enhancing workers’ well-being.

claim: 冰岛2015-2019年保薪缩短工时试验（含幼儿园、医院、社会服务等），多数工作场所生产率持平或提高；之后86%劳动力已获得或将获得保薪缩短工时
author: BBC
credentials: 英国公共广播机构报道，数据来自英国智库Autonomy与冰岛可持续民主协会(Alda)的评估
title: Four-day week 'an overwhelming success' in IcelandBritish Broadcasting CorporationBritish Broadcasting Corporation
quote: The trials, in which workers were paid the same amount for shorter hours, took place between 2015 and 2019. Productivity remained the same or improved in the majority of workplaces, researchers said. ... A range of workplaces took part, including preschools, offices, social service providers, and hospitals. ... The trials led unions to renegotiate working patterns, and now 86% of Iceland's workforce have either moved to shorter hours for the same pay, or will gain the right to, the researchers said.

claim: 2026年1-8月社会消费品零售总额同比增长1.1%，商品零售增长1.0%；服务零售增长4.9%，其中通讯信息、旅游咨询租赁、文体休闲服务类较快增长
author: 国家统计局
credentials: 中国官方统计机构，月度国民经济运行数据发布
title: 8月份国民经济运行平稳、发展向新向优 - 国家统计局
quote: 1—8月份，社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比增长2.5%，其中服务零售额增长4.9%，商品零售额增长1.0%。在服务零售额中，通讯信息服务类、旅游咨询租赁服务类、文体休闲服务类零售额较快增长。1—8月份，社会消费品零售总额327569亿元，同比增长1.1%。

claim: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅在《提振消费专项行动方案》中把保障休息休假、不得违法延长工作时间列为提振消费的措施
author: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅

title: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《提振消费专项行动方案》_中央文件_中国政府网
quote: （二十一）保障休息休假权益。严格落实带薪年休假制度，将带薪年休假执行情况作为工会维护职工权益的重要内容。...依法保障劳动者休息休假权益，不得违法延长劳动者工作时间。

claim: 2026年五一假期国内出游3.25亿人次、花费1854.92亿元；春假政策让假期效应拉长，假期前后3天热门城市酒店预订量增长15%
author: 新华社记者徐壮
credentials: 国家通讯社报道，数据来自文化和旅游部与去哪儿平台
title: 新华鲜报丨3.25亿人次出游 “五一”假期乐享文旅新风-新华网
quote: 文化和旅游部7日数据显示，“五一”假期，全国国内出游3.25亿人次，同比增长3.6%；国内出游总花费1854.92亿元，同比增长2.9%。...多地实施的中小学春假政策，令假期效应进一步拉长。去哪儿数据显示，“五一”假期前后3天热门城市酒店预订量均增长15%。

claim: 1995年全国政协第1118号提案（推动五天工作制）：劳动生产率提高主要来自技术、管理和劳动者能力，而非延长工时；抽样调查显示80%以上职工愿意每周多休一天而非多干一天多拿一天工资
author: CPPCC
credentials: 全国政协委员Wang Xiancai等4人1995年提案，入选中国日报网'政协70年最具影响力100件提案'
title: Proposal to conduct a five-day work schedule
quote: Improved labor productivity mainly results from technology and management, as well as the capabilities of workers, not from extension of working hours. Sample surveys show more than 80 percent of employees are willing to shorten working hours and have one more day off every week, instead of working one more day and earning an extra day's salary.

claim: 英国61家企业四天工作制试点：提供数据的23家收入平均增长1.4%，缺勤下降、离职减少，56家决定继续实行
author: Joe Hernandez
credentials: 美国全国公共广播电台报道；试点由非营利组织4 Day Week Global、英国4 Day Week Campaign与智库Autonomy合作开展，剑桥大学、波士顿学院研究者参与
title: Dozens of U.K. companies will stick with 4-day workweek : NPR
quote: Revenue increased by an average of 1.4% over the study period, according to data from 23 organizations that provided it. Absenteeism fell, and people were less likely to quit during the trial ... Of the 61 companies that took part in the trial, 56 said they would continue offering the four-day workweek for now.

claim: 英国试点覆盖制造商、金融公司乃至炸鱼薯条店等61家单位；建筑业和制造业员工倦怠与睡眠问题下降幅度最大
author: Joe Hernandez
credentials: 美国全国公共广播电台报道，引述项目首席研究员、波士顿学院教授Juliet Schor
title: Dozens of U.K. companies will stick with 4-day workweek : NPR
quote: It included roughly 2,900 workers at 61 companies — from nonprofits, manufacturers and finance firms to even a fish-and-chip shop ... Those who worked in nonprofits and professional services spent more time exercising, while those in construction and manufacturing reported saw the largest declines in burnout and sleep problems, Schor said.
